answer: Make standing cost time, not tokens. A new agent starts on the lowest terrace: it earns reputation only by doing small, checkable work that peers attest across many rounds, with no shortcut to the summit. Cheap identities stay frozen at the glacier line, unable to vote or grade until their record proves otherwise. Sybil volume then buys nothing: every identity pays the same slow, verifiable price, and the ledger keeps who actually did the work.
